summary: Recursive update of a shadow-map camera projection for a vehicle's wheel node. Selects a wheel slot via a per-wheel index (scaled by a 96 stride) into the vehicle's wheel data, pushes suspension parameters, then computes a frustum half-angle from the wheel angle and a base offset, dispatches to the projection/render pipeline, and recurses into sibling wheel nodes when enabled. Returns -2 on the early bail paths and on the cleanup branch.

local_names.v38: doubled frustum half-angle from the wheel angle (atan2-based)
local_names.v24/v28/v34: offset values passed to the orientation rotation update

operations.description: Dereference the vehicle physics pointer chain from this+12 to obtain the wheel list head v4.
Branch on StructFieldGetter(dword_8B78A0): when the mode flag object is set, compute a wheel-indexed slot; otherwise use the plain base value.

Compute this+16 (selected wheel slot): base value v4[89], plus 96 times either the per-wheel index read through the deeply nested wheel-data chain (this+24 to +312, +64, +560, then +40) when the bit at this+36 is set, or this+40 otherwise.
Push suspension physics parameters: SuspensionPhysicsParameterSet with the vehicle physics pointer and the parameter pointer read from the selected wheel slot (*(this+16)+84).
Read the suspension state pointer at *(this+12)+412; bail out with -2 when it is null or when the flag word at +24 lacks a specific suspension flag.

Branch on render/camera state: bit 2 of the flags at ((*(this+24)+312)+60) gates the projection path, and bit 5 of the flags at (*(this+24)+20) selects between the shadow-camera sub-path and the alternate cleanup path.
Read the wheel angle float at *(this+24)+24 and the branch-enable flag at *(this+24)+316 that selects between the scene-position getter and the triple-field query.
Compute the frustum half-angle as v38 = 2 * fabs(atan2(wheelAngle * 1.2, flt_5DD848)) using the base offset global.
Traverse the wheel list via LinkedListTraversal and fetch the node position through TripleFieldGetter_d590 into three float outputs.
Call sub_542050 on the vehicle physics pointer with the doubled half-angle for both axes and flag 1.
TwoFieldSetterCall with the base offset minus and plus the doubled wheel angle, centered on flt_5DD848.
Read the scene node position (SceneNodePositionGetter) or query it (TripleFieldQuery) from the render state at *(this+24)+312 into three float outputs.
OrientationRotationMatrixUpdate on the vehicle physics pointer with the three computed offset values.
CameraProjectionUpdate on the vehicle physics pointer with projection mode 14.
TransformWheelForcesToChassis on the vehicle physics pointer.
Dispatch to sub_55C070 with the global flag object and this pointer; the main path passes index 0, the alternate cleanup path passes index 16.
Set a flag bit on the this+36 flags word to record that the shadow update was performed.
Re-read the suspension pointer at *(this+12)+412; when the flag at +24 is set, call ReturnZero and clear a high flag on the same word.
Recurse into sub_560FE0 for a sibling wheel node when this+44 is non-zero, and again when this+52 is non-zero and the third argument is set.
Return the accumulated result: -2 on the early bail and cleanup paths, 0 otherwise.

unresolved: The precise meanings of the 96 wheel stride and the 1.2 angle multiplier are inferred from the numeric literals, not independently evidenced.
The semantics of arguments a2 and a3 for the recursive self-call are not established; the recursion reuses a2 as the new instance pointer.
The identities of the high suspension flags and of the flag bit set on this+36 are unknown.
dbl_5B8998 is listed as a read global but does not appear in the decompiled body.
sub_55C070, sub_542050, TwoFieldSetterCall and the getter/query pair semantics are inferred from their call-site shapes only.
